name: @worksai/worksai-linkengine
description: MIT-licensed PHP URL shortener, UTM campaign builder, and WordPress bridge with link-rot detection.

scripts.lint: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; ['public/index.html','src/ui/app.js','src/server.mjs','docs/CONTENT_BRIEF.md'].forEach(f=>{const c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'); if(/devinai\\.uk|devonfolio|BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY/i.test(c)) process.exit(1);}); console.log('Lint & hygiene gate passed.');"
scripts.typecheck: node --check scripts/build.mjs && node --check src/server.mjs && npx --yes --package=typescript@5.8.2 tsc --noEmit
